Jump four suits the mobile medium role. The WVE-5UX carries an ER large laser, two SRM-6s, and two vehicular grenade launchers, with a command console. Walk four, run six, jump four. The ER large laser handles direct fire. The SRM-6s handle close missiles. The command console coordinates formations.
variants.deployment: The WVE-5UX's command console enables formation command from the field. The command console coordinates formations. The ER large laser handles direct fire. The SRM-6s handle close missiles. The vehicular grenade launchers handle infantry. Jump four suits the mobile role. Be careful pushing frontline officers too far forward given the command role. A command Wyvern.

variants.name: WVE-6N
variants.overview: The Wyvern is a forty-five ton medium in service since the Star League. Walk four, run six, jump four on the 180-rated engine. Multiple variants.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six, jump four at forty-five tons on most variants. The mixed weapons cover multiple ranges. Fusion or XL engine depending on variant. Jump four suits the mobile medium role. The WVE-6N carries a large laser, two small lasers, an SRM-6, and an LRM-10. Walk four, run six, jump four. The large laser handles direct fire. The LRM-10 provides fire support. The SRM-6 handles close missiles. A Succession Wars support configuration.
variants.deployment: The WVE-6N variant is often deployed as a supporting 'Mech, using its agility and jump jets to outmaneuver opponents. The large laser handles direct fire. The LRM-10 provides fire support. The SRM-6 handles close missiles. Jump four suits the mobile support role. Standard engine survivability. A support Wyvern.

variants.name: WVE-9N
variants.overview: The Wyvern is a forty-five ton medium in service since the Star League. Walk four, run six, jump four on the 180-rated engine. Multiple variants.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six, jump four at forty-five tons on most variants. The mixed weapons cover multiple ranges. Fusion or XL engine depending on variant. Jump four suits the mobile medium role. The WVE-9N carries a large pulse laser, two medium pulse lasers, a Streak SRM-2, and an LRM-10. Walk four, run six, jump four. The pulse lasers deliver accurate fire. The Streak SRM-2 guarantees close hits. The LRM-10 provides fire support.
variants.deployment: This variant was developed by ComStar prior to the Battle of Tukayyid in 3052 as part of their Clanbuster refits. The pulse lasers deliver accurate fire. The Streak SRM-2 handles close missiles reliably. The LRM-10 provides fire support. Jump four suits the mobile role. A ComStar Clanbuster Wyvern.

variants.name: WVE-10N
variants.overview: The Wyvern is a forty-five ton medium in service since the Star League. Walk four, run six, jump four on the 180-rated engine. Multiple variants.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six, jump four at forty-five tons on most variants. The mixed weapons cover multiple ranges. Fusion or XL engine depending on variant. Jump four suits the mobile medium role. The WVE-10N carries an ER PPC, a medium pulse laser, and an LRM-10. Walk four, run six, jump four. The ER PPC handles long-range direct fire. The LRM-10 provides fire support. The medium pulse laser closes the engagement accurately.
variants.deployment: The WVE-10N was produced by Maltex Corporation starting in 3065 as a fundamental reimagining of the Wyvern's role. The ER PPC delivers strong long-range fire. The LRM-10 provides fire support. The medium pulse laser closes the engagement accurately. Jump four suits the mobile role. A long-range Wyvern.

variants.overview: The Wyvern IIC 2 is a modernised forty-five ton Clan 'Mech introduced in 3071 during the Jihad, using advanced Clan technology developed in the previous decade. Walk four, run six, jump four on the 180-rated Clan standard engine.
variants.capabilities: The IIC 2 carries an ATM-9, two heavy medium lasers, a heavy large laser, two heavy small lasers, three light machine guns, a light machine gun array, an ER flamer, and double heat sinks throughout. The heavy laser suite delivers hard-hitting close-range fire. The ATM-9 provides three-munition missile flexibility. The machine guns and flamer handle infantry. The heat sinks manage the aggressive laser load adequately.
variants.deployment: The IIC 2 is a close-range multi-role platform. The heavy laser volume at close range is the primary combat tool. The ATM-9 flexibility allows engagement at missile range before closing. The anti-infantry weapons handle infantry threats alongside the main engagement. The standard engine survivability is the foundation the close-range tactics depend on.

variants.name: XNT-2O
variants.overview: The Xanthos is a hundred-ton quadrupedal assault 'Mech with a design history stretching back to the Age of War. The quad chassis provides exceptional stability for heavy weapons. The XNT-2O is an early prototype using primitive components.
variants.capabilities: Walk three, run four. The XNT-2O carries an AC/10, two medium lasers, two small lasers, and an SRM-4 on a primitive standard engine with primitive cockpit and armour. The primitive components require period-appropriate maintenance documentation. The weapons are functional but below the performance of later production variants.
variants.deployment: The XNT-2O is a primitive prototype. Maintaining it requires primitive construction documentation that differs from production procedures. Primitive components are not interchangeable with production equivalents. Its tactical role is the same close-range fire support the production Xanthos fills, but with primitive performance across all systems.

variants.name: XNT-3O
variants.overview: The Xanthos is a hundred-ton assault quad on the Xanthos lineage. Walk three, run four on the 300-rated engine. Multiple variants. The mixed heavy weapons cover multiple ranges.
variants.capabilities: Walk three, run four at a hundred tons. Standard or compact engine depending on variant. The heavy weapons deliver overwhelming firepower. Walk three means positioning before the battle. The XNT-3O carries a PPC, an AC/20, three medium lasers, a small laser, and an SRM-6. Walk three, run four. The PPC handles long range. The AC/20 dominates close range. The medium lasers close the engagement. The SRM-6 handles close missiles.
variants.deployment: This variant's loadout is similar to its predecessor, featuring the same weapons array and armour distribution. The PPC handles long-range fire. The AC/20 dominates close range. The medium lasers close the engagement. The SRM-6 handles close missiles. Walk three means positioning before the battle. Standard engine survivability. A mixed-range assault quad.

variants.name: XNT-4O
variants.overview: The Xanthos is a hundred-ton assault quad. Walk three, run four, jump three on the 300-rated compact engine. Multiple variants.
variants.capabilities: Walk three, run four, jump three at a hundred tons on the compact engine. The compact engine improves survivability. The XNT-4O carries a heavy PPC, two light PPCs, three ER medium lasers, and an ER small laser. The heavy PPC handles medium range. The light PPCs cover close to medium range.
variants.deployment: The 4O is the jump-capable Xanthos. Jump three on this chassis is primarily for claiming elevated firing positions. The heavy PPC handles medium range. The light PPCs cover close and medium range. The ER mediums close the engagement. Jump three provides positioning. The compact engine improves survivability. A jump-capable assault quad.

variants.name: XNT-5O
variants.overview: The Xanthos is a hundred-ton assault quad. Walk three, run four, jump five on the 300-rated compact engine with endo steel. Multiple variants.
variants.capabilities: Walk three, run four, jump five at a hundred tons on the compact engine. Jump five at a hundred tons is exceptional. The XNT-5O carries an ER PPC, five medium pulse lasers, and an ER small laser. The ER PPC handles long range. The five medium pulse lasers close the engagement accurately.
variants.deployment: This variant features an experimental design that was still in development as of 3075. The endo steel internal structure frees weight for the jump equipment. The ER PPC handles long-range fire. The five medium pulse lasers close the engagement accurately. Jump five at a hundred tons is exceptional mobility. Prototype documentation applies. An experimental jump-capable assault quad.

variants.name: XNT-6O
variants.overview: The Xanthos is a hundred-ton quadrupedal assault 'Mech with a design history stretching back to the Age of War. The quad chassis provides exceptional stability for heavy weapons. The XNT-6O is an energy-heavy production variant on a compact engine.
variants.capabilities: Walk three, run four on the 300-rated compact engine. The XNT-6O carries twin PPCs, four ER medium lasers, an LRM-10, and two small pulse lasers. The twin PPCs provide the primary long-range direct fire. The ER mediums cover medium range. The LRM-10 adds indirect fire capability. The small pulse lasers handle close threats.
variants.deployment: The 6O is a fire support variant that covers multiple engagement distances. The twin PPCs and LRM-10 together handle long-range direct and indirect fire. The ER mediums sustain fire at medium range. The quad stability makes the PPCs particularly accurate on the move — a hundred-ton quad does not shake the way a biped does at speed.

variants.name: XNT-7O
variants.overview: The Xanthos is a hundred-ton assault quad. Walk four, run six on the 400-rated XL engine. Multiple variants.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six at a hundred tons on the XL engine. XL engine — side torso vulnerability. Walk four is fast for a hundred-ton quad. The XNT-7O carries two Gauss rifles and four ER medium lasers. The Gauss rifles deliver accurate long-range fire. The ER mediums close the engagement.
variants.deployment: This variant trades electronic warfare capabilities for raw speed and devastating long-range firepower. The twin Gauss rifles deliver accurate long-range fire without heat. The four ER mediums close the engagement. Walk four is fast for the weight class. XL engine vulnerability applies. A fast long-range assault quad.

variants.name: YOL-4C
variants.overview: The Yao Lien is a fifty-five ton Capellan medium on a 275-rated fusion engine with jump seven. Walk five, run seven, jump seven. Multiple variants. Jump seven at fifty-five tons is exceptional mobility.
variants.capabilities: Walk five, run seven, jump seven at fifty-five tons. Standard fusion engine — side torso survivability. Jump seven is exceptional. The YOL-4C carries two snub-nose PPCs. The snub-nose PPCs cover close to medium range without minimum range complications. Two weapons focused on direct fire.
variants.deployment: This variant features locally manufactured Ceres Arms Thrasher snub-nose PPCs and Capellan-produced CeresCom armour. The snub-nose PPCs avoid minimum range complications, delivering concentrated close-to-medium range fire. Jump seven at fifty-five tons is exceptional mobility. Standard engine survivability. A mobile snub-nose PPC medium.

variants.name: YMN-6Y
variants.overview: Paradise Enterprises built the Yeoman as a dedicated sixty-ton fire support heavy with four LRM launchers. Walk four, run six on the 240-rated standard engine. The YMN-6Y is the original production model and the chassis has no other purpose than delivering missiles from range.
variants.capabilities: Twin LRM-15s and twin LRM-10s on a standard engine. Walk four, run six. No direct fire weapons at all. The missile volume from four launchers simultaneously creates an incoming fire density that opponents with standard anti-missile capability struggle to manage. The standard engine provides survivability but the absence of any close-range weapon means anything that closes stays in range indefinitely.
variants.deployment: The YMN-6Y goes somewhere behind the line with good firing lanes and delivers four simultaneous LRM volleys. It has no self-defence capability against opponents that close range. It needs constant escort. In exchange it saturates target zones with missile fire at a rate that dedicated fire support lances use as the backbone of their indirect fire doctrine.

variants.name: YMN-10-OR
variants.overview: Paradise Enterprises built the Yeoman as a dedicated sixty-ton fire support heavy with four LRM launchers. Walk four, run six. The YMN-10-OR is a mobile upgrade adding jump jets and MML launchers.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six, jump four on a 240-rated light engine. The YMN-10-OR carries twin LRM-10s and four MML-5 launchers. The MML-5s provide SRM or LRM flexibility from the same launchers. The jump capability allows repositioning across terrain obstacles. The light engine improves side torso survivability. The missile volume is lower than the base YMN-6Y.
variants.deployment: The 10-OR trades raw missile volume for mobility and flexibility. Jump four lets it reposition across terrain that the ground-bound YMN-6Y cannot cross. The MML-5s provide SRM capability the base variant completely lacks. The light engine survives hits. Units that found the base Yeoman too static and too fragile favour the 10-OR.

variants.name: YHC-3E
variants.overview: The Yinghuochong is a thirty-five ton Capellan light on a 210-rated XL engine with jump eight. Walk six, run nine, jump eight. Multiple variants. Jump eight is exceptional mobility.
variants.capabilities: Walk six, run nine, jump eight at thirty-five tons on the XL engine. XL engine — side torso vulnerability. Jump eight is exceptional. The YHC-3E carries an ER PPC and a TAG. The ER PPC handles long-range direct fire. The TAG designates for guided munitions.
variants.deployment: This variant is typically deployed in pairs alongside heavier lance mates, using its exceptional jump mobility. The ER PPC delivers strong long-range fire. The TAG designates targets for guided munitions. Jump eight creates approach vectors no opponent can predict. XL engine vulnerability applies. A mobile designation light.

variants.name: YHC-3Y
variants.overview: The Yinghuochong is a thirty-five ton Capellan light on a 210-rated XL engine with jump eight. Walk six, run nine, jump eight. Multiple variants.
variants.capabilities: Walk six, run nine, jump eight at thirty-five tons on the XL engine. XL engine — side torso vulnerability. Jump eight is exceptional. The YHC-3Y carries a TSEMP cannon and a TAG. The TSEMP disables enemy electronics. The TAG designates for guided munitions.
variants.deployment: This variant trades raw firepower for the ability to disable enemy electronics with its TSEMP cannon. The TSEMP shuts down enemy systems. The TAG designates targets for guided munitions. Jump eight creates approach vectors no opponent can predict. TSEMP maintenance requires specific procedures. XL engine vulnerability applies. An electronic warfare light.

variants.name: BWP-X1 'Bipedal Weapons Platform'
variants.overview: The Ymir is a ninety-ton assault built for the Rasalhague forces. Walk three to four depending on variant on the primitive or standard engine. Multiple variants. Early variants use primitive technology.
variants.capabilities: Walk three, run four at ninety tons on the primitive engine. The BWP-X1 carries an AC/5, a large laser, two vehicle flamers, four SRM-2s, and two LRM-5s. The AC/5 and large laser handle range. The SRM-2s handle close missiles. Primitive components throughout.
variants.deployment: The BWP-X1 prototype features a primitive engine, limiting top speed to 53 km/h. The cockpit and armour are also primitive. The AC/5 and large laser handle range. The SRM-2s and LRM-5s provide missile fire. The vehicle flamers handle infantry. Primitive construction documentation applies. A prototype assault.

variants.name: BWP-2B
variants.overview: The Ymir is a ninety-ton assault built for the Rasalhague forces. Walk four, run six on the 360-rated fusion engine. Multiple variants.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six at ninety tons. Standard fusion engine — side torso survivability. The BWP-2B carries an AC/5, a large laser, a small laser, four SRM-2s, and two LRM-5s. The AC/5 and large laser handle range. The SRM-2s handle close missiles. The LRM-5s provide fire support.
variants.deployment: The 2B variant features improved power systems, increasing top speed by over ten kilometres per hour compared to the prototype. The AC/5 and large laser handle range. The SRM-2s and LRM-5s provide missile fire. The small laser closes the engagement. Standard engine survivability. A production assault.

variants.name: BWP-2E
variants.overview: The Ymir is a ninety-ton assault built for the Rasalhague forces. Walk four, run six on the 360-rated fusion engine. Multiple variants.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six at ninety tons. Standard fusion engine — side torso survivability. The BWP-2E carries two PPCs, an SRM-6, and an LRM-10. The twin PPCs handle long-range direct fire. The LRM-10 provides fire support. The SRM-6 handles close missiles.
variants.deployment: The 2E variant replaced the large laser and autocannon with particle projector cannons, and swapped out multiple missile launchers. The twin PPCs deliver strong long-range fire. The LRM-10 provides fire support. The SRM-6 handles close missiles. Standard engine survivability. A PPC-armed assault.

variants.name: BWP-3A
variants.overview: The Ymir is a ninety-ton assault built for the Rasalhague forces. Walk four, run six on the 360-rated fusion engine. Multiple variants.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six at ninety tons. Standard fusion engine — side torso survivability. The BWP-3A carries two large lasers, a medium laser, an SRM-6, and an LRM-10. The large lasers handle direct fire. The LRM-10 provides fire support. The SRM-6 handles close missiles.
variants.deployment: This variant features Star League-era upgrades to address heat management deficiencies, including standard large lasers. The large lasers handle direct fire. The LRM-10 provides fire support. The SRM-6 handles close missiles. The medium laser closes the engagement. Standard engine survivability. An improved assault.

variants.name: (Carson)
variants.overview: The Yu Huang is a ninety-ton Capellan assault on a 360-rated XL engine. Walk four, run six, jump four. Multiple variants. The mixed heavy weapons cover multiple ranges.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six, jump four at ninety tons on the XL engine. XL engine — side torso vulnerability. Jump four at ninety tons is exceptional mobility. The heavy weapons cover multiple ranges. The Carson carries two Gauss rifles, two light PPCs, and four ER medium lasers. Walk four, run six. The paired Gauss rifles deliver accurate long-range fire. The light PPCs handle direct fire. The ER mediums close the engagement.
variants.deployment: The Carson variant carries a custom weapons configuration built around paired Gauss rifles, one mounted in each side torso. The Gauss rifles deliver accurate long-range fire. The light PPCs handle direct fire. The four ER mediums close the engagement. XL engine vulnerability applies. Named custom variant — maintain to specific documentation. A long-range Yu Huang.

variants.name: Y-H10G
variants.overview: The Yu Huang is a ninety-ton Capellan assault on a 360-rated XL engine. Walk four, run six, jump four. Multiple variants. The mixed heavy weapons cover multiple ranges.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six, jump four at ninety tons on the XL engine. XL engine — side torso vulnerability. Jump four at ninety tons is exceptional mobility. The heavy weapons cover multiple ranges. The Y-H10G carries an ER large laser, a Gauss rifle, and six ER medium lasers. Walk four, run six, jump four. The Gauss provides accurate long-range fire. The ER large laser adds direct fire. Six ER mediums deliver dense close-range fire.
variants.deployment: This variant was designed to provide long-range striking power, replacing the autocannon and missile launcher with a Gauss rifle. The Gauss delivers accurate long-range fire. The ER large laser adds direct fire. The six ER mediums close the engagement. Jump four provides positioning. XL engine vulnerability applies. A long-range Yu Huang.

variants.name: Y-H9G
variants.overview: The Yu Huang is a ninety-ton Capellan assault on a 360-rated XL engine. Walk four, run six, jump four. Multiple variants. The mixed heavy weapons cover multiple ranges.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six, jump four at ninety tons on the XL engine. XL engine — side torso vulnerability. Jump four at ninety tons is exceptional mobility. The heavy weapons cover multiple ranges. The Y-H9G carries an ER PPC, an LB 20-X, a medium pulse laser, two medium lasers, and an LRM-10. Walk four, run six, jump four. The ER PPC handles long range. The LB 20-X dominates close range. The LRM-10 provides fire support.
variants.deployment: This variant was the original production model of the Yu Huang and established the design's reputation. It was fielded widely by the Capellan Confederation. The ER PPC handles long range. The LB 20-X dominates close range. The LRM-10 provides fire support. Jump four provides positioning. XL engine vulnerability applies. The definitive Yu Huang.

variants.name: Y-H9GC
variants.overview: The Yu Huang is a ninety-ton Capellan assault on a 360-rated XL engine. Walk four, run six, jump four. Multiple variants. The mixed heavy weapons cover multiple ranges.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six, jump four at ninety tons on the XL engine. XL engine — side torso vulnerability. Jump four at ninety tons is exceptional mobility. The heavy weapons cover multiple ranges. The Y-H9GC carries an ER PPC, an LB 20-X, a medium pulse laser, two medium lasers, and a C3 master computer. Walk four, run six, jump four. The C3 master coordinates the network. The ER PPC handles long range. The LB 20-X dominates close range.
variants.deployment: This variant features a C3 master computer replacing the LRM-10 launcher in the left torso, allowing it to serve as a network command hub. The C3 master coordinates the network. The ER PPC handles long range. The LB 20-X dominates close range. Jump four provides positioning. XL engine vulnerability applies. A command Yu Huang.

variants.name: Y-H9GB
variants.overview: The Yu Huang is a ninety-ton Capellan assault on a 360-rated XL engine. Walk four, run six, jump four. Multiple variants. The mixed heavy weapons cover multiple ranges.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six, jump four at ninety tons on the XL engine. XL engine — side torso vulnerability. Jump four at ninety tons is exceptional mobility. The heavy weapons cover multiple ranges. The Y-H9GB carries a large laser, three medium lasers, an Ultra AC/20, and an LRM-10. Walk four, run six, jump four. The UAC/20 delivers devastating double-tap close-range ballistic fire. The large laser handles direct fire. The LRM-10 provides fire support.
variants.deployment: This variant replaces the original LB 20-X autocannon with a Class 20 Ultra Autocannon, increasing its rate of fire. The UAC/20 delivers devastating double-tap close-range fire. The large laser and medium lasers close the engagement. The LRM-10 provides fire support. Jump four provides positioning. XL engine vulnerability applies. A devastating close-range Yu Huang.

variants.name: Y-H11G
variants.overview: The Yu Huang is a ninety-ton Capellan assault on a 360-rated XL engine. Walk four, run six, jump four. Multiple variants. The mixed heavy weapons cover multiple ranges.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six, jump four at ninety tons on the XL engine. XL engine — side torso vulnerability. Jump four at ninety tons is exceptional mobility. The heavy weapons cover multiple ranges. The Y-H11G carries two plasma rifles, a medium pulse laser, two medium lasers, and two MML-5s. Walk four, run six, jump four. The plasma rifles superheat targets. The MML-5s cover both LRM and SRM ranges. The lasers close the engagement.
variants.deployment: This variant mounts a pair of plasma rifles in each arm, fed by four tons of ammunition from the centre torso. The plasma rifles force heat problems on opponents. The MML-5s provide missile flexibility. The lasers close the engagement. Jump four provides positioning. XL engine vulnerability applies. A plasma Yu Huang.

variants.name: Y-H12GC
variants.overview: The Yu Huang is a ninety-ton Capellan assault on a 360-rated XL engine. Walk four, run six, jump four. Multiple variants. The mixed heavy weapons cover multiple ranges.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six, jump four at ninety tons on the XL engine. XL engine — side torso vulnerability. Jump four at ninety tons is exceptional mobility. The heavy weapons cover multiple ranges. The Y-H12GC carries an ER PPC, a medium VSP laser, a Gauss rifle, and a C3 boosted master computer. Walk four, run six, jump four. The C3 boosted master extends network coordination. The Gauss and ER PPC handle long range. The VSP laser adapts to range.
variants.deployment: This variant carries a C3 boosted master computer, enhancing command coordination beyond the standard C3 network. The C3 boosted master extends the network range. The Gauss and ER PPC handle long range. The medium VSP laser adapts to engagement range. Jump four provides positioning. XL engine vulnerability applies. A boosted command Yu Huang.

variants.name: S-YR-1LAM
variants.overview: The Yurei is a forty-ton LAM (Land-Air 'Mech) built for the Word of Blake Manei Domini. Walk five, run seven, jump five on the 200-rated fusion engine. Multiple variants. The LAM conversion capability is the design identity.
variants.capabilities: Walk five, run seven, jump five at forty tons. Standard fusion engine — side torso survivability. The S-YR-1LAM carries an ER large laser and two ER medium lasers. The ER large laser handles long range. The ER mediums close the engagement. The LAM conversion enables aerospace flight.
variants.deployment: The Yurei was deployed exclusively by Word of Blake Manei Domini formations during the final years of the Jihad. The ER large laser handles long-range fire. The ER mediums close the engagement. The LAM conversion enables aerospace flight for rapid repositioning. LAM conversion equipment requires specialist maintenance. A Blakist LAM.

variants.name: ZEU-5T
variants.overview: The Zeus is an eighty-ton assault in service since 2787, a Lyran mainstay. Walk four, run six on the 320-rated engine. Multiple variants. The autocannon or PPC plus LRM and laser combination is the design identity.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six at eighty tons on most variants. The primary weapon, LRM, and laser suite cover multiple ranges. Fusion, light, or XL engine depending on variant. The ZEU-5T carries an ER PPC, an ER large laser, two medium lasers, and an LRM-15. Walk four, run six. The ER PPC and ER large laser handle long range. The LRM-15 provides fire support. The medium lasers close the engagement.
variants.deployment: This variant is similar to the 5S, but with an ER PPC instead of the LRM-15/Artemis IV combination in the primary role. The ER PPC and ER large laser deliver strong long-range fire. The LRM-15 provides fire support. The medium lasers close the engagement. Standard engine survivability. A long-range Zeus.

variants.name: ZEU-5S
variants.overview: The Zeus is an eighty-ton assault in service since 2787, a Lyran mainstay. Walk four, run six on the 320-rated engine. Multiple variants. The autocannon or PPC plus LRM and laser combination is the design identity.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six at eighty tons on most variants. The primary weapon, LRM, and laser suite cover multiple ranges. Fusion, light, or XL engine depending on variant. The ZEU-5S carries an Ultra AC/5, an Artemis-guided LRM-15, an ER large laser, and two medium lasers. Walk four, run six. The UAC/5 delivers sustained ballistic fire. The Artemis LRM-15 improves missile accuracy. The ER large laser handles direct fire.
variants.deployment: The ZEU-5S variant mounted an Ultra AC/5 with two tons of ammunition, linked to an Artemis IV FCS on the LRM-15. The UAC/5 maintains sustained ballistic pressure. The Artemis LRM-15 improves missile grouping. The ER large laser handles direct fire. The medium lasers close the engagement. Standard engine survivability. A ballistic Zeus.

variants.name: ZEU-6S
variants.overview: The Zeus is an eighty-ton assault in service since 2787, a Lyran mainstay. Walk four, run six on the 320-rated engine. Multiple variants. The autocannon or PPC plus LRM and laser combination is the design identity.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six at eighty tons on most variants. The primary weapon, LRM, and laser suite cover multiple ranges. Fusion, light, or XL engine depending on variant. The ZEU-6S carries an AC/5, an LRM-15, a large laser, and two medium lasers. Walk four, run six. The AC/5 provides ballistic fire. The large laser handles direct fire. The LRM-15 provides fire support. The medium lasers close the engagement.
variants.deployment: This variant mounted a Defiance Type J Autocannon/5 in the left arm as its primary weapon, backed up by a Coventry LRM-15. The AC/5 provides ballistic fire. The large laser handles direct fire. The LRM-15 provides fire support. The medium lasers close the engagement. Standard engine survivability. The definitive workhorse Zeus.

variants.name: ZEU-6Y
variants.overview: The Zeus is an eighty-ton assault in service since 2787, a Lyran mainstay. Walk four, run six on the 320-rated engine. Multiple variants. The autocannon or PPC plus LRM and laser combination is the design identity.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six at eighty tons on most variants. The primary weapon, LRM, and laser suite cover multiple ranges. Fusion, light, or XL engine depending on variant. The ZEU-6Y carries an AC/5, a Binary Laser (Blazer) Cannon, and an LRM-10. Walk four, run six. The Blazer cannon delivers heavy energy fire. The AC/5 provides ballistic fire. The LRM-10 provides fire support. The heat from the Blazer requires cycling.
variants.deployment: The 6Y variant kept the AC/5 in the right arm and replaced the LRM-15 with a single LRM-10 launcher. The Binary Laser Cannon delivers heavy energy fire but generates significant heat. The AC/5 provides ballistic fire. The LRM-10 provides fire support. Heat discipline is the pilot's consideration. Standard engine survivability. A Blazer-armed Zeus.

variants.name: ZEU-6A
variants.overview: The Zeus is an eighty-ton assault in service since 2787, a Lyran mainstay. Walk four, run six on the 320-rated engine. Multiple variants. The autocannon or PPC plus LRM and laser combination is the design identity.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six at eighty tons on most variants. The primary weapon, LRM, and laser suite cover multiple ranges. Fusion, light, or XL engine depending on variant. The ZEU-6A carries a PPC, three SRM-6s, a large laser, and two medium lasers. Walk four, run six. The PPC handles long range. Three SRM-6s deliver overwhelming close-range missile volume. The large laser handles direct fire. A close-quarters configuration.
variants.deployment: Introduced in 2940, the ZEU-6A trades long-range capabilities for close-quarters firepower. This conversion trades the LRM for three SRM-6 launchers. The PPC handles long range. The SRM-6s deliver overwhelming close-range missile volume. The large and medium lasers close the engagement. Standard engine survivability. A close-range Zeus.

variants.name: ZEU-6T
variants.overview: The Zeus is an eighty-ton assault in service since 2787, a Lyran mainstay. Walk four, run six on the 320-rated engine. Multiple variants. The autocannon or PPC plus LRM and laser combination is the design identity.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six at eighty tons on most variants. The primary weapon, LRM, and laser suite cover multiple ranges. Fusion, light, or XL engine depending on variant. The ZEU-6T carries a PPC, an LRM-15, a large laser, and two medium lasers. Walk four, run six. The PPC handles long range. The large laser adds direct fire. The LRM-15 provides fire support. The medium lasers close the engagement.
variants.deployment: The 6T model's loadout is centred around the Parti-Kill PPC, which provides significant firepower but also creates heat. The PPC handles long range. The large laser adds direct fire. The LRM-15 provides fire support. The medium lasers close the engagement. Standard engine survivability. A PPC-armed Zeus.

variants.name: ZEU-9S2
variants.overview: The Zeus is an eighty-ton assault in service since 2787. Walk four, run six on the 320-rated XL engine. Multiple variants.
variants.capabilities: Walk four, run six at eighty tons on the XL engine. XL engine — side torso vulnerability. The ZEU-9S2 carries a Gauss rifle, an ER large laser, and two LRM-15s. The Gauss provides accurate long-range fire. The ER large laser adds direct fire. The twin LRM-15s deliver heavy fire support.
variants.deployment: The 9S2's loadout prioritises long-range firepower over close-range combat. The Cyclops XII ER large laser handles direct fire. The Gauss delivers accurate long-range fire. The twin LRM-15s create heavy fire support. XL engine vulnerability applies. A long-range fire support Zeus.

variants.name: ZEU-X
variants.overview: The Zeus-X is an eighty-ton assault built on the Zeus lineage with experimental technology. Walk five, run seven on the 400-rated XXL engine. Multiple variants.
variants.capabilities: Walk five, run seven at eighty tons on most variants. XXL engine — side torso damage is catastrophic. Walk five is fast for an assault. The heavy weapons cover multiple ranges. The ZEU-X carries an LB 20-X, an MRM-30, and two medium X-pulse lasers. Walk five, run seven. The LB 20-X delivers heavy close-range ballistic fire. The MRM-30 delivers overwhelming medium-range missile volume. The X-pulse lasers close the engagement.
variants.deployment: The ZEU-X variant is equipped with an LB-X Autocannon/20 as its primary weapon, backed up by an MRM-30 launcher. The LB 20-X dominates close range. The MRM-30 delivers overwhelming medium-range missile fire. The X-pulse lasers close the engagement accurately. The XXL engine makes side torso damage catastrophic. Walk five provides mobility. A close-range Zeus-X.
